correctness.rationale: Three conic quadratic forms Q1=diag(1,1,−1), Q2=diag(1/3,1,−1), Q3=diag(1,1/3,−1). Their intrinsic tangency incidence fixes C1 and preserves {C2,C3}. A map fixing C2,C3 must commute with the generalized eigenoperators Q1^-1Q2 and Q1^-1Q3; their unique 1/3 eigenspaces force both X and Y axes invariant, so the map is diagonal; Q1 then forces coordinate sign changes. Together with swapping X,Y these are all eight D8 conic symmetries. Independent exact rational action on four tangent lines gives exactly two stabilizers of {L1,L2} and four of {L1,L3}, respectively C2 and C2×C2. Exhaustive finite check occurs only AFTER symbolic completeness in PGL3(C).
